lines.trans: Congratulate me, Mateo! I found folding wooden chairs at half price!
At half price? Why do I get nervous when you say "half price"?
Because the shop only gives that price if you order two dozen at once!
Two dozen?! Ernesto, two dozen is twenty-four chairs!

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: Twelve for Room Nine, eight spares for the courtyard, and four for emergencies!
Where do we store twenty-four chairs while we paint all week?!
Relax! I told the delivery driver to bring them on Thursday afternoon.
Wait... who just parked a van right in front of our gate?
A blue van? Why does it say "Garden Chairs Express" on the side?!
Let me read your notepad... boss, you circled "Saturday at two"!
I read the wrong column without my glasses! They are unloading them already!
Twenty-four wooden chairs in our narrow courtyard. Wonderful, boss!
Congratulate me, Mateo! I found folding wooden chairs at half price!
At half price? Why do I get nervous when you say "half price"?
Because the shop only gives that price if you order two dozen at once!
Two dozen?! Ernesto, two dozen is twenty-four chairs!

words.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

lines.trans: Twelve for Room Nine, eight spares for the courtyard, and four for emergencies!
Where do we store twenty-four chairs while we paint all week?!
Relax! I told the delivery driver to bring them on Thursday afternoon.
Wait... who just parked a van right in front of our gate?
A blue van? Why does it say "Garden Chairs Express" on the side?!
Let me read your notepad... boss, you circled "Saturday at two"!
I read the wrong column without my glasses! They are unloading them already!
Twenty-four wooden chairs in our narrow courtyard. Wonderful, boss!
Congratulate me, Mateo! I found folding wooden chairs at half price!
At half price? Why do I get nervous when you say "half price"?
Because the shop only gives that price if you order two dozen at once!
Two dozen?! Ernesto, two dozen is twenty-four chairs!

lines.trans: Twelve for Room Nine, eight spares for the courtyard, and four for emergencies!
Where do we store twenty-four chairs while we paint all week?!
Relax! I told the delivery driver to bring them on Thursday afternoon.
Wait... who just parked a van right in front of our gate?
A blue van? Why does it say "Garden Chairs Express" on the side?!
Let me read your notepad... boss, you circled "Saturday at two"!
I read the wrong column without my glasses! They are unloading them already!
Twenty-four wooden chairs in our narrow courtyard. Wonderful, boss!
Until next time!

words.gloss: next (hasta la próxima = until next time)

meanings.note: Marks destination, clock time, and animate direct objects (personal a).

examples.text: Vamos a la estación ahora.
examples.trans: We are going to the station now.

examples.text: El desayuno empieza a las ocho.
examples.trans: Breakfast starts at eight o'clock.

acabar.gloss: to finish; to have just (acabar de)

meanings.en: to finish; to have just (acabar de)
meanings.note: Acabar de + infinitive means 'to have just done something'.

examples.text: Acabo de llegar del mercado.
examples.trans: I have just arrived from the market.

examples.text: Ya acabamos el trabajo de hoy.
examples.trans: We already finished today's work.

meanings.note: Mandatory contraction of preposition a + masculine article el; al + infinitive means 'upon doing'.

examples.text: Vamos al mercado por la mañana.
examples.trans: We go to the market in the morning.

examples.text: Al abrir la puerta, sonó el timbre.
examples.trans: Upon opening the door, the bell rang.

meanings.note: Spelling changes c -> qu before -e (aparqué).

examples.text: El repartidor aparca la furgoneta junto a la entrada.
examples.trans: The delivery driver parks the van beside the entrance.

examples.text: No se puede aparcar delante del portón del patio.
examples.trans: You cannot park in front of the courtyard gate.

meanings.note: Plural azules; azul marino means 'navy blue'.

examples.text: Es una pieza azul.
examples.trans: It is a blue piece.

examples.text: Espere, ¡es azul oscuro, igual que la suya!
examples.trans: Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!

bajar.gloss: to go down; to bring down; to lower

meanings.en: to go down; to bring down; to lower
meanings.note: Works both intransitively (go downstairs) and transitively (bring down).

examples.text: Bajo a la cocina a preparar té.
examples.trans: I go down to the kitchen to make tea.

examples.text: Bajamos las maletas por la escalera.
examples.trans: We bring the suitcases down the stairs.

meanings.note: Used both for stone courtyard pillars and vertical table columns in a ledger.

examples.text: Apunta el precio en la segunda columna del cuaderno.
examples.trans: Write the price in the second column of the notebook.

examples.text: Las columnas de piedra rodean todo el patio.
examples.trans: Stone columns surround the whole courtyard.

meanings.note: Unaccented in statements and time clauses (interrogative: cuándo).

examples.text: Avísame cuando llegue el taxi.
examples.trans: Let me know when the taxi arrives.

examples.text: Cuando llueve, huele a tierra mojada.
examples.trans: When it rains, it smells like wet earth.

meanings.note: Invariable cardinal number.

examples.text: Tenemos cuatro mesas dentro.
examples.trans: We have four tables inside.

examples.text: La habitación cuatro da al patio.
examples.trans: Room four looks out onto the courtyard.

meanings.note: Links possession, origin, material (de madera), and contents (taza de té).

examples.text: Es una mesa redonda de madera.
examples.trans: It is a round wooden table.

examples.text: Vengo de la estación de tren.
examples.trans: I am coming from the train station.

meanings.note: Querer decir means 'to mean'.

examples.text: ¿Qué dice la carta exactamente?
examples.trans: What does the letter say exactly?

examples.text: Dime la verdad sin miedo.
examples.trans: Tell me the truth without fear.

meanings.note: Dejar de + infinitive means 'to stop doing something'.

examples.text: Dejo las llaves en el mostrador.
examples.trans: I leave the keys on the counter.

examples.text: Déjame ayudarte con esa caja.
examples.trans: Let me help you with that box.

delante.gloss: in front; ahead (delante de = in front of)

meanings.en: in front; ahead (delante de = in front of)
meanings.note: Followed by de before a noun: delante de la puerta.

examples.text: Hay una furgoneta azul aparcada delante de la posada.
examples.trans: There is a blue van parked in front of the inn.

examples.text: Camina tú delante con la linterna encendida.
examples.trans: Walk ahead with the flashlight switched on.

meanings.note: Las doce = twelve o'clock.

examples.text: El reloj da las doce al mediodía.
examples.trans: The clock strikes twelve at noon.

examples.text: Aquí tienes doce euros de cambio.
examples.trans: Here is twelve euros in change.

meanings.note: Media docena means 'half a dozen' (six).

examples.text: Compramos una docena de tazas blancas en el mercado.
examples.trans: We bought a dozen white cups at the market.

examples.text: Rocío usa media docena de huevos para el bizcocho.
examples.trans: Rocio uses half a dozen eggs for the sponge cake.

meanings.note: Los dos / las dos means 'both'.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas azules en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two blue cups on the table.

examples.text: Compra las dos válvulas por favor.
examples.trans: Buy both valves, please.

meanings.note: Interrogative adverb with written accent.

examples.text: Mira dónde señala con el lápiz.
examples.trans: Look where he is pointing with his pencil.

examples.text: ¿Dónde van las cucharillas y las servilletas?
examples.trans: Where do the teaspoons and the napkins go?

meanings.note: Definite article; also appears before feminine nouns starting with stressed /a/ (el agua, el asa).

examples.text: El patio tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The courtyard has plenty of light.

examples.text: Pásame el libro de reservas.
examples.trans: Pass me the reservation book.

meanings.note: Expresses location inside or on top of a surface (en la mesa = on the table).

examples.text: Las tazas están en la mesa.
examples.trans: The cups are on the table.

examples.text: Vivimos en Valencia todo el año.
examples.trans: We live in Valencia all year.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (o -> ue: encuentro).

examples.text: No encuentro mis gafas de leer.
examples.trans: I cannot find my reading glasses.

examples.text: Encontramos una panadería estupenda.
examples.trans: We found a terrific bakery.

meanings.note: La maleta equivocada = the wrong suitcase.

examples.text: Es una pieza equivocada.
examples.trans: It is a wrong piece.

examples.text: equivocada
examples.trans: wrong

meanings.note: Forms: ese, esa, esos, esas.

examples.text: Pásame ese cuaderno azul.
examples.trans: Pass me that blue notebook.

examples.text: Esa maleta pertenece a un cliente.
examples.trans: That suitcase belongs to a guest.

esperar.gloss: to wait; to wait for; to hope

meanings.en: to wait; to wait for; to hope
meanings.note: Covers both 'wait (for)' and 'hope'.

examples.text: Espere un momento, por favor.
examples.trans: Wait a moment, please.

examples.text: Esperamos que descanse muy bien.
examples.trans: We hope you rest very well.

meanings.note: Pairs with locations (está en el patio) and temporary states (está caliente).

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is ready now.

examples.text: ¿Dónde están las llaves de latón?
examples.trans: Where are the brass keys?

meanings.note: Opposite of ancho (wide).

examples.text: Es una pieza estrecha.
examples.trans: It is a narrow piece.

examples.text: Coge la segunda calle, junto al puesto de flores, no el callejón estrecho.
examples.trans: Take the second street, beside the flower stall, not the narrow alley.

meanings.note: Invariable in everyday commercial names and phrases (envío exprés, café exprés).

examples.text: Pedimos un envío exprés para recibir las cajas hoy.
examples.trans: We ordered express delivery to receive the boxes today.

examples.text: Tomo un café exprés antes de abrir la recepción.
examples.trans: I drink an espresso before opening the front desk.

meanings.note: Felicitar al cocinero = compliment the chef.

examples.text: Felicito a La panadera por sus bollos.
examples.trans: I compliment The baker on her sweet rolls.

examples.text: Todos felicitaron al equipo el viernes.
examples.trans: Everyone congratulated the team on Friday.

meanings.note: Small commercial van.

examples.text: La furgoneta está aquí.
examples.trans: The delivery van is here.

examples.text: Vemos las furgonetas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the delivery vans from the door.

meanings.note: Plural-only feminine noun in Spain: las gafas.

examples.text: ¿Dónde he dejado mis gafas?
examples.trans: Where did I leave my glasses?

examples.text: Lleva unas gafas redondas.
examples.trans: He wears round glasses.

meanings.note: De golpe = all of a sudden.

examples.text: El golpe está aquí.
examples.trans: The knock is here.

examples.text: Vemos los golpes desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the knocks from the door.

guardar.gloss: to keep; to put away; to guard

meanings.en: to keep; to put away; to guard
meanings.note: Everyday verb for putting something safely away in a pocket or cupboard.

examples.text: Guardo las llaves en este cajón.
examples.trans: I keep the keys in this drawer.

examples.text: Te guardé el último rollo de canela.
examples.trans: I saved the last cinnamon roll for you.

meanings.note: Impersonal present form hay means 'there is / there are'; haber que + infinitive = must / need to.

examples.text: Hay pan caliente en la cocina.
examples.trans: There is warm bread in the kitchen.

examples.text: Ya hemos preparado las habitaciones.
examples.trans: We have already prepared the rooms.

meanings.note: Plural habitaciones.

examples.text: La habitación está aquí.
examples.trans: The room is here.

examples.text: Vemos las habitaciones desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the rooms from the door.

hacer.gloss: to do; to make; ago (hace + time)

meanings.en: to do; to make; ago (hace + time)
meanings.note: Irregular: hago, hice, hecho; hace tres años = three years ago.

examples.text: La panadera hace pan fresco cada mañana.
examples.trans: The baker bakes fresh bread every morning.

examples.text: Llegó hace diez minutos.
examples.trans: She arrived ten minutes ago.

meanings.note: ¡Hasta luego! = See you later!; ¡Hasta mañana! = See you tomorrow!

examples.text: Sigue recto hasta el puente.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead as far as the bridge.

examples.text: Nos quedamos hasta el viernes.
examples.trans: We are staying until Friday.

meanings.note: Plural jardines, without the written accent.

examples.text: Mi madre tiene flores en el jardín.
examples.trans: My mother has flowers in the garden.

examples.text: Los niños juegan en el jardín.
examples.trans: The children play in the garden.

meanings.note: Feminine: la jefa.

examples.text: El jefe está aquí.
examples.trans: The boss is here.

examples.text: Vemos los jefes desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the bosss from the door.

meanings.note: Invariable in the plural: el jueves ('on Thursday'), los jueves ('on Thursdays').

examples.text: El repartidor viene el jueves por la tarde.
examples.trans: The delivery driver comes on Thursday afternoon.

examples.text: Los jueves limpiamos todas las lámparas del patio.
examples.trans: On Thursdays we clean all the courtyard lamps.

meanings.note: Definite feminine singular article before nouns; direct-object feminine pronoun before/attached to verbs.

examples.text: La puerta del patio es azul.
examples.trans: The courtyard door is blue.

examples.text: La habitación tiene mucha luz.
examples.trans: The room has plenty of light.

meanings.note: Al lado = on the side / next door.

examples.text: El lado está aquí.
examples.trans: The side is here.

examples.text: Vemos los lados desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the sides from the door.

meanings.note: Used with feminine plural nouns and clock hours (las ocho).

examples.text: Las ventanas dan al jardín.
examples.trans: The windows face the garden.

examples.text: Desayunamos a las ocho.
examples.trans: We have breakfast at eight.

meanings.note: Third-person singular indirect object pronoun.

examples.text: Le llevo una taza de té caliente.
examples.trans: I am bringing you/her a cup of hot tea.

examples.text: ¿Le gusta la habitación del patio?
examples.trans: Do you like the courtyard room?

meanings.note: Preterite 3rd sg/pl spells y: leyó, leyeron; past participle leído.

examples.text: Leo el periódico con el primer café.
examples.trans: I read the newspaper with my first coffee.

examples.text: Anoche leímos toda la carta juntos.
examples.trans: Last night we read the whole letter together.

meanings.note: Handy pocket or desk notepad for lists and phone notes.

examples.text: Apunto todos los pedidos en una libreta pequeña.
examples.trans: I write down all the orders in a small notepad.

examples.text: Ernesto dejó su libreta abierta junto al teléfono.
examples.trans: Ernesto left his notepad open beside the telephone.

meanings.note: De madera = wooden.

examples.text: La madera está aquí.
examples.trans: The wood is here.

examples.text: Vemos las maderas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the woods from the door.

meanings.note: Warm praise.

examples.text: Es una pieza maravillosa.
examples.trans: It is a wonderful piece.

examples.text: ¡Maravilloso! Ahora estoy lista para un gran desayuno.
examples.trans: Wonderful! Now I am ready for a big breakfast.

meanings.note: First-person singular object/reflexive pronoun.

examples.text: ¿Me pasas la sal, por favor?
examples.trans: Can you pass me the salt, please?

examples.text: Vivo aquí y trabajo aquí.
examples.trans: I live here and I work here.

meanings.note: Links two simultaneous actions.

examples.text: Espera aquí mientras abro la puerta.
examples.trans: Wait here while I open the door.

examples.text: Preparo el té mientras sale el pan.
examples.trans: I make the tea while the bread comes out.

meanings.note: A mitad de precio = at half price.

examples.text: La mitad está aquí.
examples.trans: The half is here.

examples.text: Vemos las mitades desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the halves from the door.

meanings.note: Ponerse nervioso = to get nervous.

examples.text: Es una pieza nerviosa.
examples.trans: It is a nervous piece.

examples.text: ¿Nervioso por un tren de madera? Esta historia es cada hora más rara.
examples.trans: Nervous about a wooden train? This story gets stranger every hour.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender and number with the thing possessed (nuestro patio, nuestra posada).

examples.text: Nuestra posada tiene ocho habitaciones.
examples.trans: Our guesthouse has eight rooms.

examples.text: Nuestros vecinos toman café aquí.
examples.trans: Our neighbours have coffee here.

meanings.note: Las nueve = nine o'clock.

examples.text: El tren llega a las nueve en punto.
examples.trans: The train arrives at nine on the dot.

examples.text: Vimos un nueve sobre diez.
examples.trans: We saw a nine out of ten.

meanings.note: Las ocho = eight o'clock.

examples.text: Abrimos la puerta a las ocho.
examples.trans: We open the door at eight.

examples.text: La posada tiene ocho habitaciones.
examples.trans: The guesthouse has eight rooms.

meanings.note: Marks destination, recipient (para ti), deadline, and minutes to the hour (cinco para las doce).

examples.text: Este paquete blanco es para mi hermano.
examples.trans: This white parcel is for my brother.

examples.text: Faltan diez minutos para las doce.
examples.trans: It is ten minutes to twelve.

meanings.note: Traditional inner courtyard at the heart of a Spanish building.

examples.text: El patio está aquí.
examples.trans: The courtyard is here.

examples.text: Vemos los patios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the courtyards from the door.

meanings.note: Stem-changing verb (e -> i: pido, pidió).

examples.text: Pido un café con leche, por favor.
examples.trans: I will order a coffee with milk, please.

examples.text: El cartero me pidió una firma.
examples.trans: The postman asked me for a signature.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb.

examples.text: En primavera pintamos la puerta azul.
examples.trans: In spring we paint the blue door.

examples.text: El abuelo pintó una llave dorada.
examples.trans: Grandfather painted a golden key.

meanings.note: Silla plegable = folding chair.

examples.text: Es una pieza plegable.
examples.trans: It is a folding piece.

examples.text: sillas plegables
examples.trans: folding chairs

poner.gloss: to put; to set; to become (ponerse + adj)

meanings.en: to put; to set; to become (ponerse + adj)
meanings.note: Irregular: pongo, pon, puse, puesto; ponerse nervioso = get nervous.

examples.text: Pongo dos tazas limpias en la mesa.
examples.trans: I put two clean cups on the table.

examples.text: Pon la maleta junto al mostrador.
examples.trans: Set the suitcase beside the counter.

por.gloss: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)

meanings.en: through; along; by; because of; in (time of day)
meanings.note: Por la mañana = in the morning; por favor = please; gracias por = thanks for.

examples.text: Paseamos por el casco antiguo.
examples.trans: We stroll through the old quarter.

examples.text: Por la mañana entra mucho sol.
examples.trans: In the morning plenty of sun comes in.

meanings.note: One word without accent (distinct from ¿por qué? = why?).

examples.text: Abro la ventana porque hace calor.
examples.trans: I open the window because it is warm.

examples.text: Sonríe porque huele a canela.
examples.trans: She smiles because it smells of cinnamon.

meanings.note: A mitad de precio = at half price.

examples.text: El precio está aquí.
examples.trans: The price is here.

examples.text: Vemos los precios desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the prices from the door.

meanings.note: El próximo invierno = next winter.

examples.text: Es una pieza próxima.
examples.trans: It is a next piece.

examples.text: ¡Compra las dos! Una válvula de repuesto salva también el próximo invierno.
examples.trans: Buy both! A spare valve saves next winter too.

meanings.note: Covers room doors, street doors, and courtyard gates.

examples.text: La puerta está aquí.
examples.trans: The door is here.

examples.text: Vemos las puertas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the doors from the door.

meanings.note: Core connector and relative pronoun (unaccented, distinct from interrogative qué).

examples.text: Espero que descanses muy bien.
examples.trans: I hope that you rest very well.

examples.text: El pan de esta panadería huele genial.
examples.trans: The bread that The baker bakes smells great.

meanings.note: Plural quiénes; ¿de quién es? = whose is it?

examples.text: ¿Quién ha dejado este sobre aquí?
examples.trans: Who left this envelope here?

examples.text: ¿De quién es esta maleta azul?
examples.trans: Whose blue suitcase is this?

qué.gloss: what?; which?; how / what a! (in exclamations)

meanings.en: what?; which?; how / what a! (in exclamations)
meanings.note: Used in questions (¿qué hora es?) and exclamations (¡qué alivio!).

examples.text: ¿Qué hora es ahora mismo?
examples.trans: What time is it right now?

examples.text: ¡Qué mañana tan luminosa!
examples.trans: What a bright morning!

meanings.note: Feminine la repartidora; built on repartir ('to deliver / distribute').

examples.text: El repartidor trajo dos cajas grandes esta mañana.
examples.trans: The delivery driver brought two big boxes this morning.

examples.text: Firma el recibo para el repartidor en la puerta.
examples.trans: Sign the receipt for the delivery driver at the door.

meanings.note: Tener una reserva = to have a booking.

examples.text: La reserva está aquí.
examples.trans: The reservation is here.

examples.text: Vemos las reservas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the reservations from the door.

meanings.note: Regular -ar verb; rodear con un círculo means 'to circle on paper'.

examples.text: Rodea la fecha del viernes con un lápiz rojo.
examples.trans: Circle Friday's date with a red pencil.

examples.text: Las macetas verdes rodean la fuente del patio.
examples.trans: Green flowerpots surround the courtyard fountain.

meanings.note: Fin de semana = weekend; la semana que viene = next week.

examples.text: La semana está aquí.
examples.trans: The week is here.

examples.text: Vemos las semanas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the weeks from the door.

ser.gloss: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)

meanings.en: to be (identity, origin, time, permanent trait)
meanings.note: Used for names, professions, ownership (es mía), materials (es de madera), and clock time.

examples.text: Soy arquitecta y vivo en Valencia.
examples.trans: I am an architect and live in Valencia.

examples.text: Esa maleta azul es mía.
examples.trans: That blue suitcase is mine.

meanings.note: Unaccented conjunction, distinct from accented sí ('yes').

examples.text: Avísame si necesitas otra manta.
examples.trans: Let me know if you need another blanket.

examples.text: Mira si queda leche en la nevera.
examples.trans: Check whether any milk is left in the fridge.

meanings.note: Wooden or folding chair.

examples.text: La silla está aquí.
examples.trans: The chair is here.

examples.text: Vemos las sillas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the chairs from the door.

meanings.note: Followed by bare nouns (sin azúcar, sin sal) or infinitives (sin abrir = unopened).

examples.text: Tomo el té sin azúcar, gracias.
examples.trans: I take my tea without sugar, thank you.

examples.text: Salió de casa sin abrigo.
examples.trans: He left home without a coat.

solo.gloss: only; just (also adj solo/sola = alone / single)

meanings.en: only; just (also adj solo/sola = alone / single)
meanings.note: Unaccented in modern RAE spelling; café solo = black espresso.

examples.text: Solo necesito cinco minutos más.
examples.trans: I only need five more minutes.

examples.text: Queda una sola habitación libre.
examples.trans: Only a single room remains vacant.

meanings.note: El sábado means 'on Saturday'; los sábados means 'on Saturdays'.

examples.text: Los sábados vamos temprano al mercado de la plaza.
examples.trans: On Saturdays we go early to the market in the square.

examples.text: Este sábado abrimos las ventanas de la galería.
examples.trans: This Saturday we open the sunroom windows.

meanings.note: Por la tarde = in the afternoon; ¡Buenas tardes! = Good afternoon!; llegar tarde = arrive late.

examples.text: ¡Buenas tardes! ¿Tienen una habitación libre?
examples.trans: Good afternoon! Do you have a room free?

examples.text: Perdón por llegar un poco tarde.
examples.trans: Sorry for arriving a little late.

meanings.note: Small local shop.

examples.text: La tienda está aquí.
examples.trans: The shop is here.

examples.text: Vemos las tiendas desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the shops from the door.

meanings.note: Todo el día = the whole day; todo el mundo = everyone; sobre todo = mostly.

examples.text: Todo está limpio y en su sitio.
examples.trans: Everything is clean and in its place.

examples.text: Camina todo recto por esta calle.
examples.trans: Walk straight ahead down this street.

meanings.note: Irregular: traigo, traje; future traeré.

examples.text: Ahora mismo le traigo una cuchara.
examples.trans: I will bring you a spoon right now.

examples.text: Ayer trajo flores del mercado.
examples.trans: Yesterday she brought flowers from the market.

meanings.note: Said alone to reassure someone ('Easy, don't worry!').

examples.text: Es una pieza tranquila.
examples.trans: It is a quiet piece.

examples.text: Seca, calentita y tranquila. Ahora decidme qué falta.
examples.trans: Dry, warm, and quiet. Now tell me what is missing.

meanings.note: Unaccented possessive (tu llave / tus llaves), distinct from accented pronoun tú.

examples.text: ¿Dónde está tu caja de herramientas?
examples.trans: Where is your toolbox?

examples.text: Reconocí tu letra enseguida.
examples.trans: I recognized your handwriting right away.

meanings.note: Forms: un (m sg), una (f sg), unos (m pl 'some/about'), unas (f pl).

examples.text: Quiero un café caliente, por favor.
examples.trans: I would like a hot coffee, please.

examples.text: Hay una mesa libre en el patio.
examples.trans: There is a free table in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Una urgencia = an emergency.

examples.text: La urgencia está aquí.
examples.trans: The emergency is here.

examples.text: Vemos las urgencias desde la puerta.
examples.trans: We see the emergencies from the door.

meanings.note: Written as a single word in Spanish (21–29 combine into one word).

examples.text: Dos docenas de sillas son veinticuatro sillas.
examples.trans: Two dozen chairs is twenty-four chairs.

examples.text: La recepción está tranquila las veinticuatro horas.
examples.trans: The front desk is peaceful twenty-four hours a day.

meanings.note: Changes to e before words starting with /i/ sound (i- or hi-).

examples.text: Servimos café caliente y pan fresco.
examples.trans: We serve hot coffee and fresh bread.

examples.text: Son las siete y cuarto.
examples.trans: It is quarter past seven.

meanings.note: ¡Ya está! = All done!; ya no = no longer.

examples.text: El desayuno ya está listo.
examples.trans: Breakfast is already ready.

examples.text: ¡Ya voy con las llaves!
examples.trans: Coming right now with the keys!
